picks.editorial_note: A $38 million ARPA-H contract — the largest research award in UVM history — will fund AI-powered 'digital twins' of critically ill patients, a potentially life-saving advance in personalized critical care.
picks.title: Your AI Twin Could Save Your Life: UVM Awarded up to $38M…

picks.editorial_note: An NIH Director's Pioneer Award of nearly $6 million will let Weill Cornell build an AI-human discovery engine using LLM agents to generate novel cancer research hypotheses, a prestigious and rare federal honor.
picks.title: Dr. Olivier Elemento Wins NIH Director’s Pioneer Award
picks.university: Weill Medical College of Cornell University

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech and Amazon launched a formal joint Science Hub extending a decade-long partnership, institutionalizing industry-funded academic AI research at significant scale.
picks.title: Georgia Tech and Amazon Launch Joint Science Hub

picks.editorial_note: Brown engineers built a brain-inspired imaging system that can see through fog by mimicking retinal responses, a genuine scientific advance with applications from autonomous vehicles to medical imaging.
picks.title: Brown University engineers build brain-inspired imaging system that can ‘see’ through fog

picks.editorial_note: A Northeastern-developed low-power implantable chip uses machine learning to decode faulty brain activity in real time, a step toward practical neural-disorder diagnostics.
picks.title: This AI-powered chip can offer a deeper look at faulty brain activity

picks.editorial_note: UW-Madison researchers built AI tools that create individualized 'brain roadmaps' linking cellular and genetic changes to Alzheimer's disease, advancing precision approaches to a disease affecting millions.
picks.title: ‘We built a brain roadmap for each person’: New AI-driven tools help decode Alzheimer’s disease at the cellular level

picks.editorial_note: NIH-funded University of Florida research combining AI, brain mapping, and intracranial recordings aims to predict language outcomes before epilepsy surgery, directly improving a high-stakes clinical decision.
picks.title: UF researchers combine AI and brain mapping to advance personalized epilepsy surgery

picks.editorial_note: CERN's federated learning platform CAFEIN was recognized internationally at the UN's Digital@UNGA Awards for enabling privacy-preserving, cross-institutional AI model building, a notable validation of academic AI infrastructure on a global stage.
picks.title: CERN’s AI innovation recognised at Digital@UNGA Awards 2026 – Home

picks.editorial_note: A $4.25 million DARPA grant will fund a WashU-led team integrating AI with physics-based simulation to improve fuel injector design, pairing significant federal funding with a multi-institutional engineering partnership.
picks.title: WashU-led team wins $4M DARPA grant to improve fuel injector design

picks.editorial_note: UNSW students partnered with Commonwealth Bank to prototype AI-based fraud detection targeting a problem that cost Australians $2.18 billion in 2025, a concrete industry-academia collaboration with real financial stakes.
picks.title: The CBA partnership giving students the chance to solve a $2.18 billion problem
